summary: Competition check 2026-10-09 for AS04: 39 market actors recorded (17 competitors, 10 alternatives); details list what each does, its traction signal, licence and the gap versus the candidate. Source files: R5-research-os.md under docs/inquiry/agentic-stack-2026-10-09/research/.
details:
- karpathy/autoresearch [alternative]: Minimal agent loop: edit train.py, 5-minute fixed-budget run, keep/discard by val_bpb, results.tsv ledger Gap/note: Commoditized greedy inner loop; flat ledger, no epistemic status or noise handling Traction: 97.6k stars, 13.6k forks; first commit 2026-03-06 (https://github.com/karpathy/autoresearch/commits/master). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- evo (evo-hq) [competitor]: Codebase autoresearch plugin: metric discovery, tree search with parallel subagents, gates, shared failure traces Gap/note: Closest OSS inner loop with failure memory; no typed claims or outer loop found Traction: 1.5k stars; commercial platform in beta (https://github.com/evo-hq/evo). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- AIDE ML [partner]: Tree search over ML solution scripts guided by validation metric Gap/note: Usable inner-loop engine; multi-provider incl. local OpenAI-compatible Traction: 1.6k stars; MLE-bench 17.1% any-medal with o1-preview (2024) (https://github.com/openai/mle-bench). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Weco [competitor]: Commercial autoresearch engine for code built on AIDE; traceable solution tree, steerable branches Gap/note: Hosted inner loop; no stated failed-approach memory or researcher self-improvement Traction: $8M seed (vendor claim) (https://www.weco.ai/blog/seed-announcement). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- OpenEvolve [partner]: Open AlphaEvolve implementation with MAP-Elites, islands, evaluator artifacts Gap/note: Evolutionary inner loop; local models supported Traction: 7.5k stars (https://github.com/algorithmicsuperintelligence/openevolve). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- ShinkaEvolve (Sakana AI) [competitor]: LLM-ensemble evolutionary program search with novelty filtering, meta-recommendations, UCB model selection Gap/note: In-run model routing and meta-advice overlap outer-loop claims Traction: 1.4k stars; ICLR 2026; ICFP 2025 contest support (vendor claim) (https://github.com/SakanaAI/ShinkaEvolve). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- AlphaEvolve (Google Cloud) [competitor]: Gemini-powered evolutionary code optimisation agent, GA on Google Cloud Gap/note: Hosted, cloud-locked Traction: GA 2026-07-09; early adopters BASF, JetBrains, Kinaxis (vendor claim) (https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/infrastructure-and-cloud/google-cloud/alphaevolve-on-cloud/). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Microsoft RD-Agent [competitor]: Data-driven R&D agent for Kaggle/data science, quant factor/model research, fine-tuning Gap/note: Covers ML and finance loops; no documented negative-result store or trial accounting Traction: 14.9k stars; MLE-bench 35.1% (gpt-5) (https://github.com/openai/mle-bench). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- MLEvolve [competitor]: Monte Carlo Graph Search MLE agent with global success/failure-labelled experience memory Gap/note: Within-task negative memory; not cross-project Traction: 448 stars; MLE-bench 61.3% (leaderboard), 65.3% self-reported (https://github.com/openai/mle-bench). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- ML-Master 2.0 [competitor]: Long-horizon MLE agent with Hierarchical Cognitive Caching memory Gap/note: Trace-distilled memory, untyped Traction: 453 stars; MLE-bench 56.4% (https://github.com/openai/mle-bench). Licence: Not shown. Checked 2026-10-09.
- AIRA-dojo (Meta) [benchmark]: Research-agent framework with greedy/MCTS/evolutionary policies Gap/note: Non-commercial reference implementation Traction: 175 stars; MLE-bench 31.6% (o3) (https://github.com/openai/mle-bench). Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- MLE-STAR (Google Cloud research) [benchmark]: Retrieval of models from web plus targeted ablation-guided refinement Gap/note: No memory or outer loop Traction: 63% medals on MLE-bench Lite (paper claim) (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2506.15692). Licence: Research code (not inspected). Checked 2026-10-09.
- MLE-bench (OpenAI) [benchmark]: 75-competition Kaggle benchmark for ML engineering agents Gap/note: Expensive per run; Lite split cheaper Traction: 1.8k stars; top any-medal 64.4%; submissions paused (https://github.com/openai/mle-bench). Licence: See LICENSE file (type not shown). Checked 2026-10-09.
- Human-guided frontier coding agents on Kaggle [alternative]: Grandmaster-steered GPT/Gemini/Claude agents ran 850 experiments to win a Kaggle Playground Gap/note: Status-quo practice; memory is human file discipline Traction: Won March 2026 Playground (author report) (https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/winning-a-kaggle-competition-with-generative-ai-assisted-coding/). Licence: n/a. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Sakana AI Scientist v2 [competitor]: End-to-end paper generation with best-first agentic tree search and experiment manager Gap/note: Paper-centric; lower success than template v1 Traction: 7.3k stars; Nature publication 2026-03-26 (https://sakana.ai/ai-scientist-nature/). Licence: AI Scientist Source Code License (RAIL-derived). Checked 2026-10-09.
- Edison Scientific Kosmos [competitor]: Hosted AI scientist with structured world model across data and literature agents Gap/note: Structured research memory in science, closed and paid Traction: $70M seed; $200/run; 79.4% accurate conclusions (vendor claim) (https://siliconangle.com/2025/12/18/edison-scientific-raises-70m-build-autonomous-ai-scientists-research). Licence: Hosted; not stated. Checked 2026-10-09.
- FutureHouse Robin [alternative]: Multi-agent biology discovery workflow over literature and data agents Gap/note: Biology, not ML Traction: Ripasudil dry-AMD candidate (vendor claim) (https://www.deeplearning.ai/the-batch/put-the-lab-in-the-loop). Licence: Apache-2.0 (Robin); Finch platform closed. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Autoscience (Carl) [competitor]: Autonomous ML research lab offered as managed service Gap/note: Hosted enterprise ML research Traction: $14M seed led by General Catalyst (2026-03) (https://siliconangle.com/2026/03/19/autoscience-builds-automated-research-lab-machine-learning-models-14m/). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Intology (Zochi, Locus) [competitor]: Artificial scientist systems; ACL 2025 paper claim Gap/note: Closed; internals unknown Traction: ~$8M seed (tracker, low reliability) (https://www.premieralts.com/companies/intology/funding-history). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Google Co-Scientist / Gemini for Science [competitor]: Hypothesis tournament, AlphaEvolve-based computational discovery, literature insights Gap/note: Hosted, gradual access Traction: Enterprise users named by vendor (vendor claim) (https://deepmind.google/blog/co-scientist-a-multi-agent-ai-partner-to-accelerate-research/). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Microsoft Discovery [competitor]: Enterprise agentic R&D platform on graph knowledge engine Gap/note: Enterprise science, Azure-billed Traction: GA 2026-06-02 (trade press) (https://campustechnology.com/articles/2026/06/12/microsoft-discovery-platform-brings-agentic-ai-to-scientific-research.aspx). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Agent Laboratory [alternative]: Literature-to-report research workflow with co-pilot mode and AgentRxiv Gap/note: Stale since 2025-03; no failure memory Traction: 5.9k stars (https://github.com/SamuelSchmidgall/AgentLaboratory). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- AI-Researcher (HKUDS) [alternative]: Autonomous research pipeline and benchmark; hosted novix.science Gap/note: Paper-generation focus Traction: 5.8k stars; NeurIPS 2025 spotlight (https://github.com/HKUDS/AI-Researcher). Licence: Not shown. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Denario [alternative]: Modular idea/method/results/paper research assistant Gap/note: Physics/astro paper focus Traction: 613 stars; PRX Intelligence 2026-10-01 (https://github.com/AstroPilot-AI/Denario). Licence: GPL-3.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- AlphaResearch [benchmark]: Algorithm discovery with execution verification and learned review model Gap/note: Math/algorithm phase reference Traction: 2/8 wins vs human best on AlphaResearchComp (https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.08522). Licence: Released per paper (not inspected). Checked 2026-10-09.
- Harmonic Aristotle and Axiom AxiomProver [competitor]: Lean-verified autonomous proving of open problems Gap/note: Dominant in proof-vs-plausible math phase Traction: Axiom $200M at $1.6B; Harmonic $120M Series C (per Axios) (https://www.axios.com/2026/05/26/axiom-ai-math-journal). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- autocontext (greyhaven-ai) [competitor]: Recursive self-improving harness with playbooks, gated promotion, model routing, distillation Gap/note: Closest outer-loop implementation; not research-ledger specific Traction: 1.3k stars (https://github.com/greyhaven-ai/autocontext). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Sibyl System [competitor]: Claude Code-native AI scientist with reflection-driven prompt overlays Gap/note: Outer loop exists, benefit unmeasured Traction: 283 stars (https://github.com/Sibyl-Research-Team/AutoResearch-SibylSystem). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- CORAL [competitor]: Multi-agent autoresearch with shared notes/skills and grader isolation Gap/note: Covers Kaggle, kernels, Erdos problems; untyped notes Traction: 1.1k stars; COLM 2026 (https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/CORAL). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- GEPA [partner]: Reflective evolution of prompts, code and agent architectures against a metric Gap/note: Outer-loop optimiser component Traction: 6.9k stars (https://github.com/gepa-ai/gepa). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- EvoAgentX [alternative]: Framework that generates and evolves multi-agent workflows (TextGrad, AFlow, MIPRO, EvoPrompt) Gap/note: Workflow evolution, not research outcomes Traction: 3.4k stars (https://github.com/EvoAgentX/EvoAgentX). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Hindsight (vectorize-io) [partner]: Agent memory with facts, experiences, evidence-backed observations, mental models Gap/note: Candidate storage for research ledger; already selected
